bangladesh.title: তৃণমূলের ১০ বিধায়কের পদ বাতিলের আবেদন খারিজ করলেন স্পিকার

bangladesh.title: আফগানিস্তানের বিপক্ষে টসে জিতে ব্যাটিংয়ে বাংলাদেশ

tech.title: President Trump awards Big Tech donors with nation’s highest science prizes
tech.desc: Together, the awardees have donated nearly $6 billion to efforts tied to Trump and his administration.

tech.title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
tech.desc: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.

tech.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
tech.desc: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.

tech.title: Watch the trailer for ‘The Altruists,’ Netflix’s show about the FTX scandal
tech.desc: A fictionalized Sam Bankman-Fried is coming to your TV screen on November 19.

tech.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
tech.desc: Ben Affleck is going viral for his deep knowledge of AI, from neural networks and transformers to open weights. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix earlier this year, is proving he's more than just a Hollywood star.

tech.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
tech.desc: The company behind the popular LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and is now measuring AI models on alignment issues such as lying.

tech.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
tech.desc: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.

tech.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
tech.desc: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

tech.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
tech.desc: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

tech.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
tech.desc: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.
